sources.title: inclusionAI - GitHub
sources.snippet: inclusionAI contains the series of open-source projects from Ant Group with dedicated efforts to work towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). In here you can find Large Language Models (LLM), Reinforcement Learning (RL) or other systems related to model training and inference, and other AGI-related frameworks or applications.

sources.title: UI-Venus Technical Report: Building High-performance UI Agents with RFT
sources.snippet: Ant Group We present UI-Venus, a native UI agent that takes only screenshots as input based on a multimodal large language model. UI-Venus achieves SOTA performance on both UI grounding and navigation tasks using only several hundred thousand high-quality training samples through reinforcement finetune (RFT) based on Qwen2.5-VL.

sources.title: inclusionAI/UI-Venus | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: UI-Venus 1.5 is a unified, end-to-end GUI agent system designed for robust real-world applications. The system integrates model training, comprehensive evaluation, and production-ready deployment into a complete ecosystem for autonomous GUI interaction across mobile and web platforms.
